Conversation libre avec le robot, sur n': Free conversation with the robot, on any topic: “robot, I'm hungry, what do you suggest for dinner?”, “robot, what will the weather be tomorrow?”. It searches the recipes, history and the web, starts timers, manages shopping and music, and answers out loud. Online: only the sentence said after “robot” is sent (OpenAI transcription and voice, Claude answers from Anthropic). It never starts the motor.
